record.title: R70 causal manufacturing-yield attribution learning
record.body: Durable learning: control-plane causality is necessary but insufficient for manufacturing-capital accounting. A lawful Y edge must bind exact investment -> reusable primitive -> independent consumer -> qualified downstream action -> dependency unlock with currentness, qualification receipt, replay, falsifier, causal lag, and zero ambient DO. M requires remembered-state consumption and observed unlocks, not the existence of memory records. 1000X factor multiplication is observation only until reuse, consumer and composition factors are each independently evidenced >=10. Extensible semantic families must use minimum-required identities rather than a fixed total count so later courts compose without invalidating predecessors.
